QuestInfo.name: [Freud's Journal] Arnello's Weekly Goals, 4th Week
QuestInfo.0: Arnello has prepared an assignment to check on the ring's growth. Don't miss this chance to get some valuable treasures from him.
QuestInfo.1: Arnello prepared a new goal for you to check the Sylph Ring's growth. Defeat the Black Knight and Rampant Cyborg at least once each then report back to Arnello for some nice gifts.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the elite bosses Black Knight and Rampant Cyborg, and received gifts from Arnello.
